title: One View of a Mixed DNS Estate

cta.text: See Micetro across your DNS platforms

prompt:
Product: BlueCat. Demo: "One View of a Mixed DNS Estate".
Start with one welcome step whose title is exactly "Microsoft, Azure and BlueCat DNS, Managed in One Place" and whose text is exactly: Mid-migration, your zones live on different platforms. Watch Micetro list them all in one grid and narrow to any platform with one search. Nothing was changed.
Audience: network and DNS engineers and IT leaders evaluating the product. Tone: concise, confident, practical, no hype.
4 screenshots, keep this order, one tooltip per image, calling out the highlighted UI element. Use the text of each numbered tooltip EXACTLY as written; do not rewrite, shorten or merge it. Do not add a closing step or a closing message after the last screenshot; its own tooltip is the end.
1. Your DNS is spread across Microsoft, Azure, AWS and BlueCat servers. Micetro lists every zone in one grid, and the Authority column says who serves each. Narrow it to one platform by typing in the filter.
2. Typing a platform into the filter shows only its zones: here, the ones held in Azure DNS. Next, the same search for your BlueCat appliances.
3. The same filter works for BlueCat DNS appliances. One search, whichever platform serves the zone. Type any other platform and the grid follows.
4. Select a zone and its details open the same way, whichever platform serves it.
